newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium futures end mixed after dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium futures end mixed after dull trade.

text.p: Tokyo yen-based aluminium futures closed mixed after dull trade on Wednesday, with market players focusing on volatile precious metals markets, traders said.
"The metal's going to stay around $1,600 in London for a while, and here the volume's too low," said one trader.
The TOCOM benchmark April 1998 contract gained 1.0 yen to 188.9 yen per kg, while others were between 0.3 yen lower to 1.5 yen higher. Estimated volume was 1,233 lots.
In London overnight, three months aluminium finished up $2 at $1,584 per tonne, helped by a wave of trade buying which more than offset earlier commision house selling and liquidation.
